name: Excalidraw
description: Draw in Excalidraw natively: .excalidraw.md drawings compatible with the Obsidian plugin, plain .excalidraw files, SVG export, drawings embedded in notes, and agent commands (writer excalidraw:*) with the writer-excalidraw skill.

memory.note: Excalidraw (several MB with its fonts) loads when the first drawing opens or a note shows an embedded drawing; nothing runs in the background. The writer excalidraw commands and the writer-excalidraw skill are read at launch.

commands.label: New drawing
commands.description: Create a drawing next to the open note

commands.label: Export drawing as SVG
commands.description: Write the drawing as an SVG next to it
